[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Klavisor''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] assigned to the [[Elliirad Platform]]. Following an assault that the commander attributed to the [[Katarn Commandos]], an elite unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Klavisor summarized the station's losses to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Heedra]]. These losses included, but were not limited to, 2,400 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo, five S-type exterior [[fuel module]]s, one Class-H [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]] core, and two [[Strike-class medium cruiser]]s.<ref name="GaW" />
